newsitem.title: GERMANY: Kirch finds new financing from West LB - magazine.
newsitem.headline: Kirch finds new financing from West LB - magazine.

text.p: German media mogul Leo Kirch has secured a credit offer from Westdeutsche Landesbank in an effort to line up massive financing to prop up his fledgling digital television venture, a German magazine said on Saturday.

West LB would join five other banks planning to lend Kirch about 1.5 billion marks, replacing a bank controlled by the Bavarian government that dropped its credit offer under political protest, the newsweekly Focus said in a report due to appear on Monday.
Bavaria's Landesanstalt fuer Aufbaufinanzierung (LfA) had planned to loan 500 million marks to Kirch, who was struggling to attract subscribers to his DF1 satellite TV channel.
LfA's offer raised concerns about political influence in the media. West LB is 43 percent owned by the state of North Rhine-Westfalia.
